title: America vs Japan: who lives better? 4 rounds, real data
description: America against Japan in four rounds: income, life expectancy, Big Mac price and safety. Real World Bank and Economist data. Would you move?
source: World Bank: GDP per capita (2025), life expectancy (2024), homicides per 100,000 (2023); The Economist, Big Mac Index (July 2026)

segments.text: America versus Japan. Four rounds. Who lives better?
Income. America is two and a half times richer.
Life. The Japanese live five years longer.
A Big Mac. Half the price in Japan.
Safety. Murder is twenty-five times rarer in Japan.
Japan wins three to one. Would you move? Follow for more.
